text_block_list.text: A few days after the incident before the Three Goddesses statue. At the fan event held at the Tokyo Racecourse, an exhibition race was held…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Oh? Hey. Look over there where the trainers are crowding—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: There’s a shiny new rookie standing alone. Is that the one from the rumors?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Eh, you mean Buena-chan’s childhood friend!? No way, where where!? Wait wait, did you already sign a contract!? Already!? Emo…!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yes yes, that’s them! And as for now—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We’re still in a provisional contract.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, it’s about time…! I need to get ready for the race! Well then, Nakayama-san, Jordan-san, I’ll excuse myself here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Eh, seriously? “Provisional”!? What’s that supposed to meaaaan!?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: —Now, the exhibition race is entering its final stage! 400 meters left! Coming from the outside is Buena Vista! Buena Vista with a sharp finish!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Oh my! She’s got quite the finishing burst…! At this level already… hehe, with polish she’ll shine brilliantly!

text_block_list.name: Mid-career Trainer
text_block_list.text: I heard today’s exhibition had top-level competitors gathered… But yeah, even among them, Buena Vista’s on another level!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: —Goal in! First place is Buena Vista!! Buena Vista!! The one who brilliantly livened up the exhibition!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Despite not having debuted yet, it was a performance that promises a bright future. The crowd showers Buena Vista with thunderous applause!
Surrounded by roaring cheers—alone, I clench my fist tightly.
It’s vivid, overwhelming. I feel it painfully. Come to think of it—back then, she was like this too.
Back then, I had entered the academy after grueling studying… and the days were harder, harsher than I ever imagined.
choice_data_list: <size=32>(Becoming a trainer felt so far away)</size>

text_block_list.text: Before I knew it—there I stood in front of the academy gate I’d always admired. Ashamed of my own weakness, yet my eyes searched for her.
But at that moment, cheers erupted from the grounds—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hff, hff…! Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nghhhhhh…!! Amaaaaazing…!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah, this is the candidate for our year…? Looks like a losing bet for me…!
…There was no way I could “support each other” with someone like that. From outside the academy fence, seeing her from afar—she looked like a distant, unreachable star.
While I was struggling to even become a trainer, she had already left me far behind… as a runner with a shining future.
choice_data_list: <size=32>(But thinking back… maybe she always was)</size>

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Haa, huff… big brother, where are you…? Don’t leave Buu-chan behind…!!
choice_data_list: <size=32>Sorry, I’m right here! Come here, Buena...</size>

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Haa, huff… big sister, where are you…? Don’t leave Buu-chan behind…!!
choice_data_list: <size=32>Sorry, I’m right here! Come here, Buena...</size>

text_block_list.text: …I could only hold her hand like that for a very short time, when she was still so small.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hehe, ahahaha!! This way, this way!! Let’s go, big bro—…huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hehe, ahahaha!! This way, this way!! Let’s go, big sis—…huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry! I ran too fast again… I need to slow down, right? Sorry.
choice_data_list: <size=32>N-no… it’s me, sorry for being slow</size>

text_block_list.text: She soon became faster, faster, endlessly faster. Unlike me—the Umamusume who was born to run.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, found you…! Hehe, I’m glad. You came to watch the exhibition, right?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Yeah. I fully understand your current strength...</size>
<size=32>Yeah. I fully understand your current strength...</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that’s good. …So, starting tomorrow, can we begin full training?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Your provisional-contract goal from earlier— winning the “Event-Specific Competition.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …We’ll have to work very hard. There are insanely strong girls gathered this time—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Among them, the most anticipated are Scarlet-chan, who won both the Oka Sho and Shuka Sho, earning the Double Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And Vodka-chan, the Tiara Umamusume who still won the Japan Derby, said to be the dream of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Facing such representatives of the era… you said you’d make pre-debut me win. Right?
After that, I bowed my head and asked her: that she judge whether she should enter a full contract with me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Judge… um, me? Judge you? But—
choice_data_list: <size=32>…Buena, you’ve been rejecting a lot of scouts, right?</size>
<size=32>…Buena, you’ve been rejecting a lot of scouts, right?</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! …You knew?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’m surprised. I heard today was your first day—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I understand. You’re… an amazing Umamusume...
That’s why she left me behind so quickly. …But even so, I couldn’t give up.
The day I saw her beyond the fence, I ran home grinding my teeth. From that day on, I studied relentlessly, desperately.
Because I wanted to catch up. Stand beside her. Not just “because we were childhood friends”—
choice_data_list: <size=32>(I wanted to be someone she’d choose…!)</size>
<size=32>(I wanted to be someone she’d choose…!)</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I definitely want to reach the breathtaking scenery that Spe-san once showed me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So I’ll choose the trainer who fits best for that. That’s what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Well then! Starting tomorrow, I’ll be in your care, provisional trainer.
